questions.q: Completa: I only ___ my phone wasn't in my pocket when I was on the platform.

task: Escribe 6 a 8 frases sobre algo que perdiste o encontraste. Cuenta qué pasó, cómo te sentiste y cómo terminó.
paragraphs: It was a busy Friday evening and I was on the train home after work. I was very tired, so I closed my eyes for a few minutes. When the train arrived at my station, I jumped up and ran to the door. I only realised my phone wasn't in my pocket when I was already on the platform.

I felt terrible. All my photos, my contacts and my bank app were on that phone. I went to the station office, but the man there said nobody had given them a phone. "Come back tomorrow," he said. "Sometimes people bring things the next day."

When I got home, I used my laptop to call my own number. Nobody answered. Then, at about ten o'clock, my laptop rang. It was a woman called Grace. "I found your phone on the train," she said. "I saw the call, but I couldn't answer because I was driving."

The next morning I met Grace at a café near her house. She was a nurse and she was going to work, but she waited for me. I wanted to give her some money, but she said no. "Just buy me a coffee," she laughed.
I bought her a coffee and a big piece of cake. Since that day, I always check my pockets before I get off the train.
